content.short: Umbra is a protocol that enables stealth addresses on the Ethereum blockchain for anonymous transactions.
content.description: Umbra is a protocol that defines a set of standards and a smart contract to enable stealth addresses on the Ethereum blockchain. A stealth address lets a sender transfer Ether or ERC20 tokens to an address controlled by the recipient without exposing the recipient’s identity. On-chain, the transaction looks like a simple transfer to an unused address, while off-chain the sender uses a public key to generate that address by encrypting the data used to create it. Since its launch in June 2021, Umbra has processed over 85,000 transactions across all networks and remains a grant-funded public good project.
